text:
fergus: heads-up — onboarding quant3b-int4 on staging shows a mixed bag. big wins on latency/cost but a heterogeneous drop on multilingual recall and a small regression on benchmark BLEU for translation chains.
anya: numbers?
fergus: ran 600 multilingual chain prompts (en->es->zh backtranslate+summ). topline:
```
metric               fp16    int4    delta
-----------------------------------------
en_to_es_bleu        0.622   0.589   -0.033
zh_roundtrip_f1      0.708   0.669   -0.039
multilang_recall     0.801   0.774   -0.027
lat(ms)              310     195    -115
cost/tok             1.00    0.44   -56%
```
fergus: also noticed a few docs where punctuation normalization caused entity merges in languages with non-spacing marks.
tom: ok curation task. propose: 1) create a 320-item mini-golden stratified across langs and task types (translation, summarization, backtranslate, rag) 2) run translit-aware dedupe + embed-sim 3) 3-way relabel consensus, with tokenized screenshots on entity issues.
anya: agree. add a 50-item fastlane for customer repros. include synthetic adversarial translits to probe punctuation joins.
labeler-bot: created task ML-GOLD-1739999 for "quant3b-int4 multilang mini-golden". 320 items assigned; fast-lane 50 flagged. ETA 40h. :robot_face:
ops: staging note — tokenizer v3 deployed to canary images. use `--tokenizer=/opt/tokenizers/canonical:v3` for stable reference. if you need parallel eval quota request 1h ahead.
fergus: dedupe plan: `scripts/translit_embed_dedupe.sh --langs en,es,zh,ar,hi --embed-thresh 0.87 --translit` then fallback to fuzzyhash. collisions get manual triage.
tom: labeling instructions: primary=semantic recall, secondary=entity preservation. use tags: ENTITY_JOIN, DEID_SPLIT, MISNORMALIZE. require tokenized screenshots for any ENTITY_* tag. link rubric: https://confluence.redwood.ai/curation/multilang-golden
labeler-bot: dedupe started (job 1739999-dedupe). estimated collisions ~21%.
anya: quick ask — can we add an eval harness run to compare both quantized kernels (int4-opt1, int4-opt2) vs fp16? maybe one kernel is worse on certain scripts.
fergus: good call. will run `eval/harness/compare_kernels.py --models quant3b --kernels int4-opt1,int4-opt2,fp16 --subset mini-golden` after relabel. target: no >2% drop on per-lang recall and no >0.5% absolute increase in ENTITY_JOIN.
labeler-bot: relabel complete. 320 -> consensus 298 items (22 abstains). fast-lane 50 -> consensus 47 (3 abstains). upload: s3://redwood-qa/quant3b-multilang/1739999/results.json
fergus: running kernel compare now. early deltas vs fp16 on consensus set:
```
kernel      en_bleu  zh_f1  multilang_recall  entity_join_rate
----------------------------------------------------------
fp16        0.623    0.709  0.800             0.004
int4-opt1   0.595    0.673  0.772             0.018
int4-opt2   0.607    0.688  0.783             0.010
```
fergus: looks like int4-opt2 is intermediate — less harmful than opt1 on entity joins. opt1 increases entity_join notably on zh and ar.
tom: recommend try prompt scaffold C for entity-preserve ("preserve original named-entity spacing and punctuation in output"). run on a 60-probe subset (20 per kernel) to see if prompt helps opt1 enough to be acceptable.
anya: labelers can QA 60 probes in ~8h. create fast probe task.
labeler-bot: added 60 probes to ML-GOLD-1739999-probe. 12 labelers assigned. ETA 8h.
labeler-bot: probe relabel complete. consensus 58/60. probes uploaded.
fergus: re-eval with scaffold C: int4-opt1 entity_join_rate -> 0.009 (was 0.018), multilang_recall improved +0.007. Good mitigation but still slightly below opt2 on recall.
tom: decision moment: prefer int4-opt2 baseline for rollout, or int4-opt1 + scaffold if opt2 unavailable. set rollout gates: hold if per-lang recall drop >1.5% or ENTITY_JOIN >1.0% absolute. also add kernel-level alerting.
ops: noted. will provision limited dedicated canary with both kernels enabled behind feature flag. ops owner needed 2h heads-up before rollout.
anya: I'll update golden registry: `quant3b-int4-multilang-mini-20250620` and attach S3 paths + dedupe traces.
fergus: filing rollout ticket RW-1739999 with owners fergus (owner), tom (metrics), anya (curation), ops (ops). scheduling 48h limited canary with dashboards for per-lang recall, ENTITY_JOIN, kernel comparison heatmap. thanks team :tada:
